name: OneSource Specialty Pharma Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2007, OneSource Specialty Pharma Ltd is in the research, development, manufacture and commercialisation of bio logical drug products in various injectable formats. It also offers end-to-end CDMO services across all phases of pre-clinical and clinical development and commercial supply of biologics[1]
keyPoints: Business Overview:[1][2][3] OSSPL is a fully integrated, multi-modality Contract Development and Manufacturing Organisation (CDMO) based in India. The company is the first and only CDMO to hold three G7 semaglutide approvals, supplying multiple partners across key off-patent markets.
